# ECB source original

`eurofxref-hist.zip` contains exact bytes downloaded from the [ECB history resource](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-hist.zip?b59ff8e198cf5d409c4b4adff1f9421a) on 2026-09-17 at 14:54 UTC. Source: European Central Bank. ZIP SHA256: `56a389450a063c0637462db6e33575b45048e181a8071adc9cef2438c97c9e51`; CSV member SHA256: `9ee21621a088d3ad15247846e98d27bf4ac19c863e165f6817eff0e6e87770ae`.

The project calculates a separate CNY per USD reference cross from the same-day CNY per EUR and USD per EUR rates. This calculation is a project transformation, not a rate directly published by the ECB. Tests of archived originals do not certify sources or establish historical publication times. Attribution and reuse evidence are recorded in the main workspace's `.scratch/pring-data-acquisition-repair/evidence-27-cnh-alternatives-20260917/`.
